fixChoice.choice: ordered label union with per-series label lookup (not rejection)
fixChoice.why: The primitive's job is to display caller-supplied series; sparse/ragged series are a legitimate shape, and throwing would break callers for data that can be represented exactly. The union keeps every rendered point in the table, and the per-series lookup associates each value with its own label. The same union drives the SVG x-domain, so geometry and the accessible table cannot disagree.
fixChoice.duplicatePolicy: A duplicate label inside one series keeps its first value (one union position; later duplicates are not separately tabulated). Documented in the module comment.
